verdict.rationale: There is an API for developers ('use our API directly to take full control of your workflow') and Zapier integration, but no evidence of API coverage parity with UI features (checks, registered agent, TruLease/TruResidence, security settings, automation rules), and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or docs feed. missing for 10: OpenAPI/reference docs proving full feature parity, evidence that specific UI actions (check deposit, registered agent workflows, 2FA setup) are exposed via API, independent confirmation of API completeness.
